maturity_definitions.VISION: Concept or long-term intent without implemented code for this capability.
maturity_definitions.SOURCE_CANDIDATE: Relevant engineering source exists but does not implement the entire claimed capability.
maturity_definitions.SOURCE_TESTED: Bounded source implementation has test definitions; independent operational release is NOT verified.
maturity_definitions.LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO: Only local, fabricated-data demo behavior is represented; NOT customer data or live provider connectivity.

security_control_definitions.TENANT_ISOLATION: Prove tenant boundaries and deny cross-tenant access.
security_control_definitions.LEAST_PRIVILEGE: Use least-privilege identities and scoped permissions.
security_control_definitions.EXPLICIT_APPROVAL: Obtain per-action authorization and human approval before effects.
security_control_definitions.AUDIT_TRAIL: Preserve tamper-evident receipts and accountability for permitted operations.
security_control_definitions.PRIVACY_CONTROLS: Validate consent, minimization, retention and data protection.
security_control_definitions.INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION: Supply tests, negative cases and independent acceptance evidence.
security_control_definitions.STAGING_SECURITY: Prove approved private staging, secure ingress and MFA.
security_control_definitions.RECOVERY_EVIDENCE: Verify independent off-host backup, restore and incident recovery.
security_control_definitions.EXTERNAL_ACTION_DENY: Block all external writes, publishing and payment without separate release.
security_control_definitions.CONTENT_RIGHTS: Verify rights to content, likenesses, media and platform terms.
security_control_definitions.DOMAIN_EXPERT_REVIEW: Require qualified review and cited sources for sensitive or religious guidance.

Operational use requires Foundation F04-F09 verification, private staging, sector safety/privacy authorization, genuine identity and customer consent.
